name: critical
meaning: Blocks a core workflow, loses data, crashes or exposes private data
example: Checkout broken; delete with no confirmation

name: high
meaning: A major feature is broken with no workaround

name: medium
meaning: Works with a noticeable problem and a workaround
example: Over 5 s load; layout broken on phones only

name: visual
meaning: Overlap, clipping, broken images, alignment, dark-mode problems

name: functional
meaning: Broken links, dead buttons, validation, redirects, lost state

name: ux
meaning: Confusing navigation, dead ends, no feedback, vague errors

name: content
meaning: Typos, stale text, placeholder text, cut-off text, empty states

name: performance
meaning: Slow load, janky scroll, layout shift, heavy images

name: console
meaning: Uncaught errors, failed requests, mixed content

name: accessibility
meaning: Alt text, labels, keyboard, focus, ARIA, contrast
